Iterables

Source: R/utilities-iterables.R, R/zz-aliases.R
iterables.Rd

Ports of the iterators of sympy.utilities.iterables, each returning a list of everything the SymPy generator yields, in SymPy's order. Sequences are R vectors or lists.

Small helpers from sympy.utilities.iterables: flatten(), unflatten(), group() (runs of equal elements), take(), variations(), sift(), has_dups(), has_variety(), rotations(), prefixes(), postfixes(), numbered_symbols(), dict_merge() and topological_sort().

Usage

reshape_seq(seq, how)

multiset(seq)

ibin(n, bits = NULL, str = FALSE)

common_prefix(...)

common_suffix(...)

strongly_connected_components(G)

connected_components(G)

rotate_left(x, y)

rotate_right(x, y)

least_rotation(x, key = identity)

minlex(seq, directed = TRUE, key = identity)

multiset_combinations(m, n, g = NULL)

multiset_permutations(m, size = NULL, g = NULL)

ordered_partitions(n, m = NULL, sort = TRUE)

binary_partitions(n)

uniq(seq)

generate_bell(n)

generate_involutions(n)

multiset_derangements(s)

generate_derangements(s)

random_derangement(t, choice = NULL, strict = TRUE)

necklaces(n, k, free = FALSE)

bracelets(n, k)

generate_oriented_forest(n)

runs(seq, op = function(a, b) a > b)

sequence_partitions(l, n)

sequence_partitions_empty(l, n)

kbins(l, k, ordered = NULL)

permute_signs(t)

signed_permutations(t)

roundrobin(...)

partitions(n, m = NULL, k = NULL, size = FALSE)

multiset_partitions(m, k = NULL)

flatten(x)

unflatten(x, n = 2)

group(x, multiple = TRUE)

take(x, n)

variations(x, n, repetition = FALSE)

sift(x, f)

has_dups(x)

has_variety(x)

rotations(x)

prefixes(x)

postfixes(x)

numbered_symbols(prefix = "x", n = 10, start = 0)

dict_merge(...)

topological_sort(vertices, edges, key = NULL)

Arguments

seq, x, l, s, t

A sequence (vector or list); for take() also a generator.

how

A nested list of counts.

n, y, size

Integers.

bits

Number of bits, or "all" for all bit strings of length n.

str

Return strings.

...

Lists to merge.

G

A graph list(V, E) with E a list of pairs.

key

For topological_sort(), a function giving the sort key of a vertex (the vertex itself by default).

directed

Directed rotation only.

m

A sequence, or a named vector of counts, for the multiset functions; for partitions() the largest number of parts.

g

Internal: the grouped form of m, as in SymPy.

sort

Sort the partitions.

choice

A function choosing an element of a vector.

strict

Fail when no derangement exists.

k

An integer; for partitions() the largest part, for multiset_partitions() the number of parts.

free

Count rotations and reflections as equal.

op

A binary predicate for runs().

ordered

NULL, 0, 1, 10 or 11, as SymPy's kbins().

multiple

For group(), return runs instead of value and count.

repetition

Allow repeated elements.

f

A key function.

prefix

Symbol prefix.

start

First index.

vertices, edges

A graph, with edges as pairs.

Value

A list (or a vector or string where SymPy returns one).

A list or logical.

Examples

ordered_partitions(5, 3)
#> [[1]]
#> [1] 1 1 3
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] 1 2 2
#> 
kbins(1:4, 2)
#> [[1]]
#> [[1]][[1]]
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> [[1]][[2]]
#> [1] 2 3 4
#> 
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [[2]][[1]]
#> [1] 1 2
#> 
#> [[2]][[2]]
#> [1] 3 4
#> 
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> [[3]][[1]]
#> [1] 1 2 3
#> 
#> [[3]][[2]]
#> [1] 4
#> 
#> 
multiset_permutations(c(1, 1, 2))
#> [[1]]
#> [1] 1 1 2
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] 1 2 1
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> [1] 2 1 1
#> 
binary_partitions(5)
#> [[1]]
#> [1] 4 1
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] 2 2 1
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> [1] 2 1 1 1
#> 
#> [[4]]
#> [1] 1 1 1 1 1
#> 
flatten(list(1, list(2, list(3))))
#> [[1]]
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> [1] 3
#> 
group(c(1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 3))
#> [[1]]
#> [1] 1 1
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> [1] 3 3 3
#> 
topological_sort(1:4, list(c(1, 2), c(2, 3), c(1, 4)))
#> [1] 1 2 3 4
